papers.title: Spatiotemporal intensity-cycling microscopy unveils many-body interactions and correlated transport in van der Waals semiconductors
papers.authors: Jakhangirkhodja A. Tulyagankhodjaev, Michelle E. Reynoso, Yongseok Hong, Haowen Su, Yoonseo Nah, Shan-Wen Cheng, André L. Koch Liston, Xavier Roy, Milan Delor
papers.abstract: Spatiotemporal optical microscopies are powerful tools to image the propagation of energy carriers in materials, including electrons, excitons, magnons and polaritons, providing key functional metrics inaccessible to contact-based transport measurements. Nevertheless, these approaches do not distinguish single-particle from multi-particle quantum states, hindering the study of many-body correlations that underlie the complex phase diagrams at the heart of contemporary materials research. Here we extend a concept derived from multidimensional spectroscopy, called intensity cycling, to the spatiotemporal domain using transient scattering microscopy. We leverage this approach to selectively image single-particle and multi-particle transport in van der Waals semiconductors. We demonstrate a series of sought-after capabilities, including clean isolation of single-particle charge transport with high signal-to-noise ratio, spatiotemporal tracking of exciton–exciton annihilation, high-throughput mapping of dielectric disorder, and imaging the emergence of a polaronic Mott transition and correlated transport in a superatomic solid. This work delivers a precision tool capable of visualizing how many-body interactions shape material function. Intensity-cycling spatiotemporal microscopy separates single-particle and multi-particle transport, enabling imaging of charge mobility, exciton interactions, and correlated many-body states in van der Waals semiconductors, including Mott transitions.
papers.summary_en: This work extends intensity cycling to spatiotemporal transient-scattering microscopy to distinguish single-particle from multiparticle transport in van der Waals semiconductors. The method is used to image charge transport, exciton–exciton annihilation, dielectric disorder, and correlated transport associated with a polaronic Mott transition.

papers.physics_advance: The study images many-body transport, including the emergence of a polaronic Mott transition in a superatomic solid.
papers.relevance_reason: The microscopy method is central, but its application provides experimental access to correlated transport and a polaronic Mott transition in quantum materials.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究将强度循环拓展至时空瞬态散射显微术，以区分范德华半导体中的单粒子与多粒子输运。该方法用于成像电荷输运、激子—激子湮灭、介电无序，以及与极化子莫特转变相关的关联输运。
papers.method_en: The authors adapt intensity cycling, a concept from multidimensional spectroscopy, to spatiotemporal transient-scattering microscopy. This approach selectively images single-particle and multiparticle transport in van der Waals semiconductors.
papers.method_zh: 作者将源自多维光谱学的强度循环概念应用于时空瞬态散射显微术。该方法可选择性成像范德华半导体中的单粒子与多粒子输运。
papers.result_en: The method isolates single-particle charge transport with high signal-to-noise ratio and tracks exciton–exciton annihilation in space and time. It also enables high-throughput mapping of dielectric disorder and imaging of the emergence of a polaronic Mott transition and correlated transport in a superatomic solid. Together, these demonstrations show that the approach can distinguish transport channels and visualize many-body effects in material function.
papers.result_zh: 该方法以高信噪比隔离单粒子电荷输运，并对激子—激子湮灭进行时空追踪。它还可高通量绘制介电无序图，并成像超原子固体中极化子莫特转变的出现及关联输运。总体而言，这些演示表明，该方法能够区分不同输运通道，并可视化多体效应对材料功能的影响。
papers.future_en: Further applications could use the technique to compare single-particle and multiparticle transport across additional van der Waals materials and phases. The abstract establishes several capabilities but does not specify particular future systems or experiments.
papers.future_zh: 后续可将该技术用于更多范德华材料和相，比较其中的单粒子与多粒子输运。摘要展示了多项方法能力，但未指定具体的后续体系或实验。

papers.title: Evolution of the Superfluid Density in Infinite-Layer Nickelates
papers.authors: Bai Yang Wang, Shannon P. Harvey, Kyuho Lee, Yijun Yu, Yonghun Lee, Motoki Osada, Chaitanya Murthy, Srinivas Raghu, Harold Y. Hwang
papers.abstract: Nickelate superconductors provide a valuable new platform for the study of unconventional superconductivity that is complementary to the cuprates. One of the central puzzles about high-temperature superconductors is what factors determine the scale of their superconducting transition temperature ($T_\mathrm{c}$). To address this question for infinite-layer nickelates, we present a systematic mutual inductance study of the superfluid density across the doping-dependent superconducting dome of $\mathrm{Nd}_{1-x}\mathrm{Sr}_x\mathrm{NiO}_2$. We observe a weak superfluid stiffness that exhibits an approximately square-root correlation with $T_\mathrm{c}$. We also find a strong interplay between Nd magnetism and the superconducting phase, manifested as a substantial low-temperature suppression of superfluid density. These observations highlight the importance of superconducting phase fluctuations in limiting $T_\mathrm{c}$ and unexpectedly strong coupling between the Nd 4$f$ moments and the superfluid.
papers.summary_en: This study maps superfluid density across the doping-dependent superconducting dome of infinite-layer Nd₁₋ₓSrₓNiO₂ to investigate factors associated with the superconducting transition temperature. It reports weak superfluid stiffness, an approximate square-root relationship between stiffness and T_c, and a strong interplay with Nd magnetism.

papers.physics_advance: Infinite-layer nickelates exhibit weak superfluid stiffness approximately correlated with the square root of Tc, while Nd magnetism substantially suppresses the low-temperature superfluid density, implicating phase fluctuations and coupling to Nd 4f moments.
papers.relevance_reason: This experimental study directly probes superconducting stiffness and its coupling to rare-earth magnetism across the doping dome of a quantum material.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究测量无限层 Nd₁₋ₓSrₓNiO₂ 超导穹顶不同掺杂下的超流密度，以探究与超导转变温度相关的因素。研究发现超流刚度较弱、刚度与 T_c 近似呈平方根关系，并且超流与 Nd 磁性之间存在显著相互作用。
papers.method_en: The authors use systematic mutual-inductance measurements to study superfluid density across the doping-dependent superconducting dome. They examine its relation to T_c and its low-temperature evolution in the presence of Nd magnetism.
papers.method_zh: 作者采用系统的互感测量，研究掺杂依赖的超导穹顶范围内的超流密度。研究分析了超流密度与 T_c 的关系，以及 Nd 磁性存在时其低温演化。
papers.result_en: The measured superfluid stiffness is weak and exhibits an approximately square-root correlation with T_c. The superfluid density is substantially suppressed at low temperatures, indicating a strong interplay between Nd magnetism and superconductivity. The authors interpret these observations as highlighting the importance of superconducting phase fluctuations in limiting T_c and unexpectedly strong coupling between Nd 4f moments and the superfluid.
papers.result_zh: 测得的超流刚度较弱，并与 T_c 近似呈平方根关系。超流密度在低温下显著受抑，表明 Nd 磁性与超导之间存在强烈相互作用。作者认为，这些结果凸显了超导相位涨落对 T_c 的限制作用，以及 Nd 4f 磁矩与超流之间出乎意料的强耦合。
papers.future_en: Further measurements across doping could test how robust the reported stiffness–T_c scaling is and clarify its relationship to the superconducting dome. Measurements that track the low-temperature suppression alongside Nd magnetism could further characterize their interplay; the abstract does not specify such follow-up experiments.
papers.future_zh: 可在不同掺杂下开展进一步测量，以检验所报告的刚度与 T_c 标度关系是否稳健，并厘清其与超导穹顶的联系。结合 Nd 磁性追踪低温超流抑制，可进一步刻画两者的相互作用；摘要未具体说明此类后续实验。

papers.title: Resolving phonons in superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ at sub-unit-cell resolution
papers.authors: Xiaowen Zhang, Jiade Li, Xiaoyue Gao, Ruochen Shi, Bo Han, Xiaomei Li, Jinlong Du, Jinsheng Wen, Shichong Wang, Congcong Le, Xianxin Wu, Wentao Zhang, Peng Gao
papers.abstract: Abstract The role of phonons in cuprates remains controversial, with their complex lattice structure complicating the investigation. Here, we identify phonon modes originating from charge reservoir and superconducting layers of Bi 2 Sr 2 CaCu 2 O 8+δ using sub-unit-cell resolved electron energy loss spectroscopy in a scanning transmission electron microscope. We reveal several phonon modes exhibiting layer-specific localization: ~78 meV in-plane modes localized in the CuO 2 planes, ~42 meV hybrid (in-plane and out-of-plane) modes in the CuO 2 planes, and ~38 meV hybrid modes in the BiO layers. We also observe a periodic modulation of phonon frequencies induced by the superstructure, spatially correlating with the superconducting gap variation. Our findings offer new insights into the lattice dynamics in cuprates, fostering deeper exploration of the microscopic linkage between structural modulation, electronic inhomogeneity, and electron-phonon coupling.
papers.summary_en: Using sub-unit-cell-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy, this study identifies layer-localized phonon modes in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈+δ and reports a superstructure-related periodic frequency modulation that spatially correlates with superconducting-gap variation.

papers.relevance_reason: The experiment directly probes lattice dynamics and their spatial relation to electronic inhomogeneity in a cuprate superconductor.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究利用亚晶胞分辨电子能量损失谱，在 Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈+δ 中识别出具有层定位特征的声子模，并报告了与超结构相关的周期性频率调制；该调制在空间上与超导能隙变化相关。

papers.method_zh: 作者在扫描透射电子显微镜中开展亚晶胞分辨电子能量损失谱测量，以识别来自电荷储层和超导层的声子。
papers.result_en: They identify approximately 78 meV in-plane modes localized in CuO₂ planes, approximately 42 meV hybrid in-plane and out-of-plane modes in those planes, and approximately 38 meV hybrid modes in BiO layers; phonon frequencies also show a superstructure-induced periodic modulation spatially correlated with superconducting-gap variation.
papers.result_zh: 研究识别出约 78 meV、定位于 CuO₂ 平面的面内模，约 42 meV、位于这些平面的面内与面外混合模，以及约 38 meV、位于 BiO 层的混合模；声子频率还呈现由超结构引起的周期性调制，并在空间上与超导能隙变化相关。
papers.future_en: Further work could investigate how the observed spatial correlation between phonon-frequency modulation and superconducting-gap variation relates to structural modulation and electron–phonon coupling; the abstract does not specify particular follow-up measurements.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可探究所观察到的声子频率调制与超导能隙变化之间的空间相关性，如何关联结构调制及电子—声子耦合；摘要未具体说明后续测量方案。

papers.title: Similarity of Fractional Chern Insulators to Fractional Quantum Hall States: Moiré-Enhanced Gaps and Excitation-Spectrum Correspondence
papers.authors: Siddhartha Sarkar, Yitong Zhang, Kai Sun
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) realize fractional quantum Hall topology in lattice bands, but their excitation spectra remain far less understood than their ground states. Here we establish a theoretical principle relating the periodic electron-density modulations of flat Chern bands to the many-body gap and excitation spectrum of FCIs. Contrary to the conventional view that such density modulations are detrimental to fractional topology, we show that different reciprocal-lattice Fourier components play sharply distinct roles: components at smaller reciprocal lattice vectors suppress the FCI gap, whereas components at larger reciprocal lattice vectors enhance it. By suppressing the harmful small-wave-vector components and amplifying the beneficial large-wave-vector components, the gap enhancement can, in principle, be made arbitrarily large within the projected flat-band theory. Moreover, the same enhancement factor rescales the full low-energy spectrum, making the FCI excitation spectrum predictable from the corresponding Landau-level problem. We further generalize this correspondence to non-Abelian states. Applying this principle to moiré Chern bands, we identify these reciprocal-lattice density components as practical diagnostics for robust FCIs.
papers.summary_en: This theoretical work relates reciprocal-lattice Fourier components of density modulations in flat Chern bands to fractional Chern insulator (FCI) gaps and excitation spectra. It argues that suppressing smaller-wave-vector components while enhancing larger ones can increase the gap and rescale the low-energy spectrum in correspondence with Landau-level states, including non-Abelian states.

papers.relevance_reason: This theoretical work advances understanding of fractional Chern insulators, their many-body gaps, and their excitation spectra in lattice and moiré bands.

papers.method_en: The authors develop a theoretical principle connecting density-modulation Fourier components in flat Chern bands with FCI many-body gaps and excitation spectra. They distinguish the effects of different reciprocal-lattice wave vectors, extend the correspondence to non-Abelian states, and apply it to moiré Chern bands.
papers.method_zh: 作者建立了一项理论原理，将平坦陈能带中的密度调制傅里叶分量与 FCI 多体能隙及激发谱联系起来。他们区分不同倒格矢波数分量的作用，将这一对应关系推广至非阿贝尔态，并应用于莫尔陈能带。
papers.result_en: The analysis finds that small reciprocal-lattice-vector components suppress the FCI gap, whereas larger-vector components enhance it. Within the projected flat-band theory, suppressing the former and amplifying the latter can, in principle, make the gap enhancement arbitrarily large. The same enhancement factor rescales the full low-energy spectrum, making it predictable from the corresponding Landau-level problem. The authors also generalize the correspondence to non-Abelian states and propose the density components as practical diagnostics for robust FCIs in moiré Chern bands.
papers.result_zh: 分析表明，较小倒格矢分量会抑制 FCI 能隙，而较大倒格矢分量会增强能隙。在投影平带理论范围内，抑制前者并放大后者，原则上可使能隙增强任意大。同一增强因子还会缩放整个低能谱，使其可由相应的朗道能级问题预测。作者还将这一对应关系推广至非阿贝尔态，并提出可将这些密度分量作为莫尔陈能带中稳健 FCI 的实用诊断指标。
papers.future_en: A direct next step is to test the predicted gap and excitation-spectrum correspondence in specific moiré Chern-band systems. Measuring or calculating the relevant density Fourier components could also assess whether they reliably diagnose robust FCIs, including non-Abelian states; the abstract does not report such tests.
papers.future_zh: 一个直接的后续方向是在具体莫尔陈能带体系中检验所预测的能隙与激发谱对应关系。测量或计算相关密度傅里叶分量，也可评估其能否可靠诊断稳健 FCI（包括非阿贝尔态）；摘要未报告此类检验。
